#pragma once
// ===== Pin map: ESP32-S3 N16R8 + 2.4in 240x320 ST7789 SPI TFT =====
// TFT pins: SCK=12, MOSI=11, CS=10, DC=9, RST=8, LED/BL=7
// Joystick: VRx=GPIO1, VRy=GPIO2, SW=GPIO4; A=GPIO5, B=GPIO6; buzzer=GPIO13
// No touch controller or RGB LED is used by this build.
#define PIN_JOY_X    1
#define PIN_JOY_Y    2
#define PIN_JOY_SW   4
#define PIN_BTN_A    5
#define PIN_BTN_B    6
#define PIN_BUZZER   13

// ===== Behaviour =====
#define FRAME_MS      33
#define JOY_THRESH    900
#define JOY_HYST      250
#define JOY_DEAD      260
#define JOY_RANGE     1700
#define JOY_FILT      3
#define BTN_SWAP_AB   1
#define JOY_SWAP_XY   0
#define JOY_INVERT_X  0
#define JOY_INVERT_Y  0
// Screen backlight brightness is configured in the in-game Settings screen.
